flagged.title: The Invasion of Kuwait, August 1990
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly attributes the declaration of Kuwait as Iraq's '19th province' to 8 August rather than 28 August 1990, which directly contradicts the corrected lesson key facts and would cause students to fail lesson knowledge check questions.

mark_affecting.quote: By August 8th, he went from limited coercion to full-blown annexation. He literally erased Kuwait from the map, declaring it the 19th province of Iraq.
